title: LagFactory
description: The only factory guaranteed to produce lag, fun, and maybe fire.
body:
# **LagFactory**
**Version:** 1.21.1 (NeoForge)  
**Type:** Tech + Magic + Exploration + Performance  

---

## Overview
**LagFactory** is a massive NeoForge modpack built to push Minecraft to its absolute creative and technical limits. Featuring hundreds of content, performance, and utility mods, this pack lets you build colossal factories, explore breathtaking terrain, and harness the powers of both technology and magic — all while your PC begs for mercy.

Whether you’re automating with **Create**, mastering spells with **Ars Nouveau**, or conquering dungeons from **YUNG’s Better Dungeons**, there’s always something new to discover. LagFactory merges performance optimizations like **ModernFix**, **Sodium**, **FerriteCore**, and **BadOptimizations** to make the chaos *almost* playable.

---

## Key Features
- **Tech & Automation:**  
  Create, AE2, Iron Furnaces, Create: Additions, Numismatics, and more.
  
- **Magic & Combat:**  
  Ars Nouveau, Iron’s Spellbooks, Artifacts, Better Combat, and Health Enchants.

- **World Generation & Exploration:**  
  Terralith, Nullscape, Tectonic, BOP, YUNG’s structures, Incendium, and Structory overhaul every biome and dungeon.

- **Building & Decoration:**  
  Adorn, Macaw’s Furniture Suite, Chipped, Refurbished Furniture, and Rechiseled.

- **Performance Enhancements:**  
  Sodium, Lithium, ModernFix, FerriteCore, BadOptimizations, Entity Culling, Ksyxis, and more.

- **Quality of Life:**  
  Jade, JEI, Inventory Profiles Next, Mouse Tweaks, Chat Heads, and Controlling.

- **Visuals & Audio:**  
  Iris + Oculus shaders, Pretty Rain, Sound Physics Remastered, Blur, and Falling Leaves for immersive vibes.

---

## Version Info
- **Minecraft:** 1.21.1  
- **Loader:** NeoForge

## Recommended Specs
| Component | Minimum | Recommended |
|------------|----------|-------------|
| **CPU** | 4-core (e.g. Ryzen 3 / i5 8th Gen) | Ryzen 7 / i7 or better |
| **GPU** | GTX 1060 / RX 580 | RTX 3060+ |
| **RAM** | 8 GB (allocated 6+) | 16–32 GB (allocate 8–12 GB) |
| **Storage** | SSD strongly recommended | NVMe SSD for faster world loading |
| **Java** | 17 or newer (Adoptium recommended) | 21 (Temurin or Zulu builds work great) |

---

## Notes
- This pack is heavy. Expect long startup times and a few stutters on first world load.  
- If performance dips, try disabling extra structure/worldgen mods or lowering simulation distance.  
- Shaders optional but encouraged for full chaos experience.
